title: RepoWise cloud mirror list
description: Repositories the remote index host mirrors read-only. owner/name stay private to each deployment; the file shipped here carries placeholders only.

defaultCredentialEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the read-only deploy credential (an SSH private-key file path) used for repositories without their own credentialEnv. The variable's VALUE is never stored here.

owner.description: Git hosting account/organization name (private to the deployment).

name.description: Repository name at the host (private to the deployment).

alias.description: Stable short name used for the mirror dir, index checkout, status JSON and the connector's stale-index lookup. Choose RepoWise workspace aliases here.

url.description: Fetch URL, SSH form preferred (git@<git-host>:<owner>/<name>.git) so a read-only deploy key authenticates it.
